title: MWS 8-year resurvey — Family History
description: Family history of breast cancer in the participant's mother, father, and sister, reported at the 8-year resurvey. Shrunk to breast-cancer-only compared to resurvey_3yr's 13-condition block, but adds a sister field not asked about in either other table.

F2MCABR.title: Family history (mother): breast cancer
F2MCABR.$comment: Checkbox-style: only '1=Yes' documented, no '2=No'. Available on every questionnaire version, no -1 code (unlike some of resurvey_3yr's mother/father family-history fields).

F2SCABR.title: Family history (sister): breast cancer
F2SCABR.$comment: Same checkbox-style treatment as F2MCABR. New relative not asked about in recruitment or resurvey_3yr -- this wave is the only one of the three that surveys sisters.
